def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    order = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    for rr in order:
        row = grid[rr]
        out.append(list(reversed(row)) + row[:])
    return out
